import os

class Handler(http.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

        data = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', '0')))
        f = open(os.path.join(base, 'received/latest.bin'), 'wb')

        self.end_headers()
http.HTTPServer(('', 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
